$comment: Sort UI 2.0 Button Group (Orientation Horizontal and Vertical: four Outline buttons) and Button Group Text (1x PNG, get_screenshot). The group renders are cropped to the group's box (Figma's export adds the Controls/secondary-control shadow's 2 px margin). Button Group Text is drawn on a transparent canvas, so only its size and spec are compared.

entries.$why: Figma renders Button Group Text on a transparent canvas (its fill is a 2 % tint), so the PNG has no page behind it; the spec check compares the size, padding, gap, fill and text.

$thresholdsWhy: maxSizeDelta 8: the horizontal group lays four "Button" labels side by side, and each renders ~1.7 px narrower than Figma (glyph rasterisation, see the Environment line), so the row is ~6.7 px narrower. One button stays within ±2 px in references/button-group-item.
